items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: How about T.O.? T.O. He was a professional, too.

ctx.x: air music? Asking did they play? Did they play
air music? No, all them musicians. They were a little professional. How about T.O.? T.O. He was a professional, too. And he stopped playing really. Yeah. Yeah. He's old. He's around there 80.
Tell him I want to know about the Barrel House, though. The Barrel? About the Barrel House clarinet players. He say he want to know about the Barrel House clarinet players.
